in_sanskrit.name: अजेय
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who cannot be conquered, subdued, or overcome by any external force.

in_hindi.name: Ajey
in_hindi.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Invincible, Unconquerable
in_hindi.long_meaning: Ajey एक हिंदू नाम है जो भारतीय संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The name Ajey is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘ajayah’, which means ‘invincible’ or ‘unconquerable’. In Hindu mythology, the god Vishnu is often referred to as Ajeyan, representing his infinite power and invulnerability.
